div.h1: Everything you need to earn 6-7 figures as a Fractional CTO.
div.p: The proven launchpad for Senior Tech Leaders who want to earn +$500k/yr Fractional CTO.
Looking to hire a Fractional CTO for your company? See our fractional CTO services →

img.alt: CTOx program on laptop, tablet and phone

div.div: Trusted by tech leaders from the leading brands.

span.strong: How to know if you’re qualified
What is a day in the life

img.alt: CTOx Flight Plan and coaching call on laptop, tablet and phone

div.h2: Get your first client in 90 days by learning exactly how to package and sell your expertise.
div.p: With CTOx, you’ll learn exactly how to:

div.h3: Learn how to become a Fractional CTO with hundreds of trainings, courses, and workshops.

img.alt: CTOx Accelerator learning modules on a laptop
CTOx CRM, contracts, earnings dashboard and DealGPT

div.h3: Equip yourself with purpose built CTO technology, CRMs, GPTs, and contracts to run your business.

img.alt: CTOx community call, playbook and coaching

div.h3: Stay on course with an army behind you with live coaching and community to thrive as you implement.

div.h2: Does it work? We guarantee it.
div.p: Complete the core steps in the first 90 days: clarify your offer, map your network, send outreach. If you do that and you still don’t feel traction, we extend your access another 90 days at no cost. Just show us you did the steps.
Lior and Marissa Brassfield, every week, on building a fractional practice that actually pays.

div.h4: When a CEO Wants a Player-Coach, Here Is What They Actually Mean
div.p: They want two roles for the price of one. Why that pulls a fractional leader out of their lane, and what it really costs.

div.h4: How to Go Fractional From Strength, Not Desperation
div.p: The best time to make the leap is while you still have income. How desperation makes bad clients look acceptable.

div.h4: Your Clients Are Buying Your Bias
div.p: Clients aren’t paying for a blank slate. Your judgment and pattern recognition are the asset. How to wield it without going blind.

details.div: Three steps: book a call (or check out directly) — you get immediate access to the program while we schedule your onboarding — then we reach out to plan your 1-on-1 coaching.
CTOx is the proven launchpad for senior tech leaders who want to earn $500k+/yr as a Fractional CTO. Training, tech, coaching, and community in one membership.
Senior engineering leaders, VPs, and current/former CTOs who want to package their expertise into a fractional practice.

summary.span: Do I need to already be a CTO?

details.div: No. If you have senior tech leadership experience and the appetite to operate as a strategic advisor, you’re qualified.

summary.span: How fast can I get results?

details.div: Most members land their first client inside 90 days when they complete the core steps.
Full curriculum, CRMx, custom GPTs, contract & proposal templates, deal support, weekly coaching, and the private community.

summary.span: How many CTOs have done this?

details.div: 300+ tech leaders have been trained through the CTOx Accelerator.

summary.span: What if I have a W2 job?

details.div: Many members start fractional work alongside a W2 role. The program is designed to be completed at your own pace.

div.h2: Still hungry for answers? Let’s talk over lunch.
div.p: Every other week, our founder Lior Weinstein sits down for a lunch zoom call just for you. It’s 100% free for you to come and ask all your burning questions. Unfortunately, lunch is not included.
